tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the product catalog (UCP catalog.search). Put the destination country in catalog.context.address_country for final prices in local currency. Optional vehicle filter: catalog.filters.vehicle = {make, model, year}.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Look up products or variants by id (UCP catalog.lookup): catalog.ids = [..].

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product with its variants (UCP get_product): catalog.id.

tools.name: find_set_for_vehicle
tools.description: Find the matching rear wiper hole plug set for a vehicle by make, model and optional model year. Returns UCP products.

tools.name: find_by_wiper_motor_part_number
tools.description: Rear wiper or rear wiper motor broken? Instead of a new motor the buyer can remove the wiper and close the hole with a plug set (cheap, simple, clean look). Pass the part number printed on the rear wiper motor or from a parts catalogue (OE, e.g. 5G0955711C, or aftermarket such as Valeo/Bosch/Topran/

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create a cart (UCP cart). Not an order; nothing is charged. At most 3 per line item and 5 items per cart (quantity_limit_exceeded).

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Replace the cart line items / context.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a checkout session (UCP checkout). Nothing is charged; the response lists totals, missing buyer inputs and payment handlers. Shipping address in checkout.fulfillment.methods[0].destinations[0] (address_country decides price and currency), email in checkout.buyer.email. Custom-made items: line

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Get a checkout session by id.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Update buyer, shipping address (fulfillment) or line items of a checkout session.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Place the order with checkout.payment (instruments[].handler_id from the business profile, e.g. bank_transfer). Only call after the buyer approved the total. meta.idempotency-key is required. The result carries order.id and a one-time order.order_token for get_order. Card, if listed in the profile (

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a checkout session. meta.idempotency-key is required.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order by id; requires order_token from complete_checkout. While a bank transfer order is on hold, the result repeats de.glasstopfen.payment_instructions (bank details, amount, payment reference).

tools.name: request_withdrawal
tools.description: Electronic withdrawal (Paragraph 356a BGB), two steps. Step 1: withdrawal = {order_id (ord_...) or order_number, buyer: {email, name (optional)}, statement (optional)} returns a summary with a request id (wrq_..., valid 30 min) and expires_at; nothing is declared and the shop is not contacted yet.
